assumptions: Claim 2608 reserves version 20260909005945 and objects function public.queue_nightly_rebuild_style_groups and function public.refresh_style_group_counts_batch; the second is over-declared and deliberately left untouched

public.queue_nightly_rebuild_style_groups has no prior migration file; its body is re-derived from supabase/ci-bootstrap/010_pre_adoption_baseline.sql rather than merged from a competing CREATE OR REPLACE
public.update_bulk_operation replaces the rebuild-style-groups object wholesale, so the reconcile marker must be a separate top-level BULK_OPERATIONS key
The worker-signalled variant of #2440 and the alert that consumes last_reconciled_at are PopDAM application work in another repository and are not claimed here
Contract tests were executed from empty on a disposable local PostgreSQL cluster built the CI way, and pass with the new body installed

The Database Contract Tests lane applies supabase/ci-bootstrap/010_pre_adoption_baseline.sql BETWEEN its two migration replay passes, so a migration that replaces a baseline routine and succeeds in pass 1 is overwritten by the baseline. This migration therefore deletes the baseline's copy of public.queue_nightly_rebuild_style_groups, which is the remedy the baseline's own instructions name; the baseline grants are left as idempotent no-ops.

No shared database writes and no data seeding

goal: Stop the style-group asset-count reconcile running on the clock 2h15m before the rebuild that changes the membership it counts. Delete cron job nightly-reconcile-sg-asset-counts, turn nightly-rebuild-style-groups into a 10-minute poll, and rewrite public.queue_nightly_rebuild_style_groups as a three-armed driver: enqueue once per UTC day at or after 06:00 UTC, reconcile in 500-group chunks only when the rebuild reaches status completed with an unreconciled run_id, and reconcile unconditionally if the last one is older than 7 days so the new silent failure mode is bounded and observable.
